tex_content.html:
Definition
[Closed linear operator] 1. appD:D.3-def-3\group Functional Analysis A linear operator $A:X\to Y$ is closed if \[ u_k\to u\text{ in }X,\quad Au_k\to v\text{ in }Y \quad \Longrightarrow \quad Au=v. \]
